title: Enhanced audio-tactile PPS after echolocation training
citation: Tonelli, A., et al. (2019). Enhanced audio-tactile multisensory interaction in a peripersonal task after echolocation. Experimental Brain Research.
notes: Seven-speaker looming apparatus on the participant's left side. The preload recreates the reported seven-distance lateral audio-tactile PPS task as a virtual moving white-noise trajectory with paired distance/timing rows, 28 tactile-only baselines, and 28 auditory-only catches. Exact original loudspeaker-switch code, gain transfer, response timeout, and unfixed experimenter-started ITI remain provenance caveats rather than blockers for a runnable toolkit profile.

reference_parameters.reported_trial_formula: 84 audio-tactile trials (7 distances/timings x 12 repetitions), 28 tactile-only baseline trials, and 28 auditory-only catch trials = 140 trials per pre/post PPS session.
reference_parameters.apparatus_recreation_policy: The physical seven-loudspeaker array is represented with the toolkit's lateral binaural moving-source renderer using the reported 119-to-17 cm path and paired seven distance/timing samples.

provenance.source: Methods report 140 trials: 28 tactile-only, 28 catch, and 12 trials for each audio-tactile combination.
Methods report a seven-speaker array with 17 cm between loudspeakers.
